versions.changelog:
goldskill 1.0.0

- Initial release of an international futures quantitative analysis system.
- Supports real-time market data, technical analysis, and relevant news for gold (XAUUSD), silver (XAGUSD), crude oil (CRUDEOIL), natural gas (NATGAS), and copper (COPPER).
- Includes keyword triggers for multiple languages and commodities.
- Installation via pip and health-check command provided.
